cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)

project(nlm_python VERSION 1.0.0 LANGUAGES CXX)

# Python bindings sources (will be generated by pybind11)

find_package(pybind11 QUIET)

if(pybind11_FOUND)
    # Add Python bindings module
    pybind11_add_module(nlm_python_ext
        # Pybind11 bindings source files
        pybind11_bindings.cpp
    )

    target_link_libraries(nlm_python_ext PRIVATE nlm_core nlm_brain nlm_memory nlm_prediction nlm_cognition nlm_neuromodulation nlm_development nlm_agent nlm_world nlm_phase)

    # Install Python module
    install(TARGETS nlm_python_ext
        LIBRARY DESTINATION lib/python${PY_VERSION_MAJOR}.${PY_VERSION_MINOR}/site-packages
    )
else()
    message(WARNING "pybind11 not found. Python bindings will not be built.")
endif()
